text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthHow a Sick Chicken Revolutionized Cancer ResearchAnd the story of the man responsibleJCBy Jake Currie11:00 AM CDT on October 30, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleViruses can cause cancer. It’s something that’s well-established now, but the discovery was initially dismissed by the scientific community. Now, a new review published in Genes & Cancer is telling the story of the man responsible: Francis Peyton Rous. Rous was working at the Rockefeller Institute studying cancer in 1909 when a chicken farmer brought in a Barred Plymouth Rock hen with a large tumor on its breast. Unbeknownst to either of them (and especially the chicken), they would forever alter the field of cancer research. Read more: “A Look at How Many Cancers Are Caused by Infections Worldwide”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
